summary: Frontend-only verification of the free-delivery celebration on /cart when cart total (1 713 ₽) exceeds temporarily-lowered threshold (1 000 ₽). All four requested checks pass: REACHED state markup, ring-emerald glow, confetti burst (20 spans, transient), and clean console (only pre-existing unrelated 403 analytics resource).

verified_features.evidence: [data-testid=free-delivery-bar] present; [data-testid=free-delivery-reached] present with text 'Бесплатная доставка активирована!'; [data-testid=free-delivery-remaining] correctly ABSENT.

verified_features.feature: Emerald ring highlight on REACHED bar
verified_features.evidence: bar class attribute = 'glass-card p-4 mb-6 relative ring-2 ring-emerald-300/70' — contains 'ring-emerald' as required.

Within ~0.5s of /cart load, 20 confetti <span> elements with inline backgroundColor were found inside [data-testid=free-delivery-bar] (matches CONFETTI array length of 20). After waiting 3.5s, confetti spans disappeared (count=0), matching the ~2.4s celebrate timeout.

verified_features.feature: Party-popper icon rendered in REACHED label
verified_features.evidence: SVG icon present inside the bar next to the 'Бесплатная доставка активирована!' label (lucide-react PartyPopper).

verified_features.feature: Progress fill emerald/teal gradient at threshold
verified_features.evidence: Fill div class = 'h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 to-teal-500'; visually the bar reaches the full right edge (confirmed via screenshot). Header readout shows '1 713 / 1 000 ₽'. Note: the inline width style was measured at 61.37% mid-animation (framer-motion 0.6s tween from 0→pct); after animation completes the bar fills to the configured Math.min(100, pct)=100% — visually verified in screenshot.
2 cart items rendered ([data-testid^=cart-item-]), 1 upsell hint visible, checkout-button present and clickable, Итого summary intact (Товары 2 / К оплате 1 713 ₽).
Only 1 console error captured: 'Failed to load resource: 403' on an unrelated analytics/tracker resource (same pre-existing error noted in iteration_65). No React warnings, no JS exceptions.

critical_code_review_comments: CartPage.js: progress fill width style is calculated as Math.min(100, pct) which is correct, but the framer-motion animation from 0 → final width takes 0.6s; an automated test that snapshots width during this window will see an intermediate value. Not a bug — flagging only because any future automated regression should wait ≥700ms after bar appears before asserting fill width.
Confetti animation duration is 1.8s with celebrate timeout of 2.4s — the 600ms buffer prevents visible cut-off on the latest piece. Good.

CONFETTI array is module-scoped (computed once at module-load with Math.random); deterministic per session. Acceptable, but consider useMemo inside the component if you ever want fresh randomization per mount.
test_credentials: user@demo.com / demo123 (Client) — used as instructed; cart already had 2 items totaling 1 713 ₽.
seed_data_creation: None — leveraged the temporarily-lowered free-delivery threshold (1 000 ₽) set by main agent for this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After this iteration the main agent will revert the free-delivery threshold back to 5 000 ₽ (or delivery_enabled=false). To re-test the REACHED state in future, either (a) raise cart total above current threshold, or (b) temporarily set min_free_delivery low again via admin/delivery-settings. The non-reached state (remaining label + rose gradient) was previously verified in iteration_65.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as designed. All confetti pieces, ring glow, party-popper icon, and reached-state copy render exactly per spec.
